name: puzzles
why: Simon Tatham's collection of one-player logic puzzles, excellent and unusual, with a long tail of strange grids to solve.

brief.what_it_is: Puzzles is a collection of one-player puzzle games, according to the Homebrew formula description. Each game ships as its own executable, and the formula installs about 40 of them, including blackbox, bridges, dominosa, galaxies, loopy, net, pearl, signpost, tents, and untangle. I could not load the homepage or a repository README, so I have no first-hand account of how the games look or play. The scout note calls it Simon Tatham's collection of logic puzzles with unusual grids.
brief.install_notes: Installed through Homebrew as the formula 'puzzles'. Nothing beyond that was readable, so I have no notes on runtimes, configuration, or first-run steps.
brief.standout: The formula bundles a large set of separate logic puzzles, each as its own command, and the scout note describes them as unusual, with a long tail of strange grids. I could not confirm this from the source.
brief.status: unknown. Neither the homepage nor the GitHub repository could be read, so I found no release date, commit date, or maintenance note.
brief.caveats: The homepage was unreachable (URLError), so this brief rests on the formula's name, description, and executable list plus the scout note.
